result.rationale: The rescue-cautious profile is blocked by survival and spatial pressure rather than information or policy. The team repeatedly loses health to hostile reactions (Raider Holt scatter-blast hits Medic Reyes -21 and Engineer Imani -29/-25) and to the reactor environment (reactor-heat climbs 62→100, dealing 10 damage/turn to anyone in reactor zones). Engineer Imani drops from 100 to 26 health by turn 6, and Security Chen from 110 to 80, while reactor-heat hits 100 (max). Critically, the medic escorts civilian-sato but is repeatedly contested on the extraction route: turn 4 medic-reyes move:junction-cover is contested with target_zone_capacity_lost, and the escort path toward rescue-airlock is blocked by pirate-captain-veyra and pirate-raider-holt occupying junction-cover. Meanwhile the team funnels through reactor-entry (capacity contested repeatedly, engineer-imani contested at turn 5 move:reactor-console) while taking environmental reactor damage. The core bottleneck is that the actors cannot reach/use the rescue affordance because hostile occupancy and zone capacity plus reactor environmental damage block the spatial route and drain health before extraction can complete. This is survival-spatial-pressure: health, position, capacity, and hostile pressure block the actor before the useful affordance (extracting the escorted civilian) becomes actionable.
